articles.headline: A timeline of how Donald Trump, Dana White forged friendship through the fights
articles.description: Donald Trump and Dana White's friendship is on display cageside, on political stages and at the White House.

images.alt: UFC president Dana White and U.S. President Donald Trump

images.caption: Donald Trump announced in 2008 he would partner with clothing brand Affliction to put on an MMA promotion to rival Dana White's UFC.
In a speech at the 2016 Republican National Convention, White calls then-presidential candidate Trump "a fighter who will fight for this country."
Trump hosted then-UFC champion Colby Covington at the White House in 2018.
Trump is the first sitting U.S. president to attend a UFC event when he appeared at UFC 244 in New York.
After pleading not guilty to 34 felony counts in New York, Trump appeared at UFC 287 in Miami to a thunderous applause from the crowd.
White introduced the Republican nominee for president, Trump, at the 2024 Republican National Convention.
White was seated behind U.S. presidents at Trump's second presidential inauguration.
Trump shows off renderings of the arena the UFC is building for its June 14 event at the White House.

images.alt: Ultimate Fighting Championship CEO Dana White speaks as U.S. President Donald Trump looks on in the James S. Brady Press Briefing Room of the White House on November 09, 2026 in Washington, DC.
images.caption: Dana White addresses the media in the White House briefing room as President Donald Trump looks on.
Dana White joins "The Pat McAfee Show" to discuss his move into boxing and his UFC event at the White House.
